description: Cost in US dollars of calling one model, from the tokens in and out per request and the number of requests, at today's price. Handles cached input tokens and the batch price where the model has one. Use llm_price_lookup first if you are unsure of the model id.

cached_input_tokens.description: How many of the input tokens are read from the prompt cache. Default 0.

model.description: Model id such as "openai/gpt-6.1-sol-pro", or an exact model name.

use_batch_price.description: Use the batch price if the model has one. Default false.

name: llm_cost_estimate
title: Estimate an LLM API bill
